bagPolicy.summary: Small bags and purses are allowed. Backpacks, large bags and oversized purses or totes are not, and every guest and bag is searched before entry.
bagPolicy.quote: Small bags and purses are allowed.

parking.summary: The Social doesn't have its own lot, but there is plenty of parking downtown. The FAQ links to Downtown Orlando's parking page for garages and lots.
parking.quote: There is plenty of parking available downtown

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Social. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Social doesn't serve food right now. You can bring in food you buy from Planet Pizza around the corner. To drink, you must be 21+ with a valid, unexpired and scannable ID.
concessions.quote: if you purchase food from around the corner at Planet Pizza you are able to bring it inside.

accessibility.summary: The venue is at street level with wheelchair accessible restrooms, and ADA seating is always available. If you need accommodations, skip the line and go to the front entrance. You can also call or text (407) 839-1847 ahead of time.
accessibility.quote: Yes, our venue is at street level and we have wheelchair accessible restrooms.

reEntry.summary: The Social hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is at The Beacham entrance, 46 N Orange Ave, and you ring the doorbell when you arrive. It's open weekdays during the day, and hours can change. Shows are marked 12+, 18+ or 21+, and you need email approval to bring anyone under 12.
ticketPickup.quote: The box office is located at The Beacham entrance 46 N Orange Ave - please ring doorbell upon arrival.

gates.summary: The Social hasn't published entry and doors details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
